result.rationale: The migration inserts legacy embeddable_hosts values verbatim via SQL string interpolation ('INSERT ... VALUES (\'#{h}\' ...)') with no stripping of scheme/path, while EmbeddableHost#record_for_host matches via where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host). A legacy setting value like 'http://discourse.org/1234' (which the removed old code explicitly supported) would be stored unnormalized and never match, breaking embedding for previously allowed hosts. The model's before_validation normalization is bypassed because records are inserted via raw SQL.
